summary.text: Spencer Igo is a Republican member of the Minnesota House of Representatives for District 7A who is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He lives in Wabana Township and previously worked for Representative Jason Lewis and Representative Pete Stauber's district office, and he faces Democrat Erin Ningen in the general election.

paragraphs.text: Spencer Igo lives in Wabana Township, Minnesota, and graduated from Grand Rapids High School.
He earned a B.S. in public administration from the University of North Dakota in 2018.
His career experience includes working as a field director for Congressman Jason Lewis (R-Minn.) and in the district office for Congressman Pete Stauber (R-Minn.).
Igo defeated Joe Abeyta in the 2020 general election for District 5B.
In 2022 he won the general election for District 7A over Julie Sandstede, and he defeated Aron Schnaser in 2024.
In the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the Climate and Energy Finance and Policy, House Housing Finance and Policy (Co-Chair), and Ways and Means committees.
